base_member_text: depp computed before dep is NaN-masked (L54 vs L58) — same ordering as the MATLAB sibling; dep masked in-place accumulates across frames without reload
audit_member_text: `depp` is calculated at L54 before current masking, while only eta, baseline dep, u, and v are masked at L57-L60; concentration and evolving depth/depth change remain unmasked, so dry/sentinel values appear in panels 2 and 3 while panel 1 and arrows hide them.

Baseline `dep` is mutated to NaN at L58 and never restored. On the next frame, depp=dep1-dep at L54 already inherits all historical dry NaNs, and further masking accumulates, making multi-frame depth changes history-dependent.

base_member_text: plt.show() in the loop (L126) blocks per frame; figures are not cleared between snapshots
audit_member_text: There is no figure/axes clear or close inside L41-L126, so artists and newly created colorbar axes accumulate across frames.

audit_member_text: `np.log10(ch)` at L86 lacks a positivity/missing-value guard; zeros become -Inf and negatives become NaN, inconsistent with the finite [-1,1] display range.
